column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key / M<TAB>task shader key or -<TAB>native task / mesh pipeline key (pso_skey hex: the mesh shader in the vertex place).

# The native task / mesh pipelines the device's own list recorded over boot, menus and several sports on v65536 (M2 Max, 2026-11-10): the offline pipeline archive holds no task / mesh pipeline, so without these a first start builds each at its first draw (0.1-1.1 ms each with a warm Metal cache; a cold cache is not measured). The render pipelines are left out: their bases with a vertex layout are not in the offline archive, and listing all 2,146 made a first start's prepare step 19.4 s, against about 0.3 s of builds spread over the first session without them (hybrid pipelines draw meanwhile).
